name: Dale
self_text: I am a Nigerian non-binary person in my early 20s. I enjoy knitting to relax. I use a Sony camera. I am looking for a structured instruction session at a slow pace. I also want someone to teach me post-processing. I am free on Saturday afternoons, Sunday afternoons, or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace, and you have to be into a structured instruction session or a practice session working on specific shots. It's a deal-breaker unless you are the one who teaches me post-processing. It would be nice if you are available Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon, or weekday evenings, but no big deal.
